insert into BOK_SUBJECT(BOOKSET_ID,SUBJECT_NO,SUBJECT_NAME,FSUBJECT_ID,SUBJECT_TYPE,SUBJECT_LEVEL,BAL_FLAG,DATA_SOURCE,STATUS,REMARK,ERR_MSG,CREATE_USER,CREATE_DEPT,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME) select * from ( select TEMP.* from ( SELECT #{booksetId} BOOKSET_ID,#{subjectNo} SUBJECT_NO,#{subjectName} SUBJECT_NAME,#{fsubjectId} FSUBJECT_ID, #{subjectType} SUBJECT_TYPE,#{subjectLevel} SUBJECT_LEVEL,#{balFlag} BAL_FLAG,#{dataSource} DATA_SOURCE, #{status} STATUS,#{remark} REMARK,#{errMsg} ERR_MSG,#{createUser} CREATE_USER, #{createDept} CREATE_DEPT,#{createTime} CREATE_TIME,#{updateUser} UPDATE_USER,#{updateTime} UPDATE_TIME from dual )TEMP where not EXISTS ( select 1 from BOK_SUBJECT a where a.BOOKSET_ID = TEMP.BOOKSET_ID AND a.SUBJECT_NO = TEMP.SUBJECT_NO ) ) a; update BOK_SUBJECT a,( select * from ( select TEMP.* from ( SELECT #{booksetId} BOOKSET_ID,#{subjectNo} SUBJECT_NO,#{subjectName} SUBJECT_NAME,#{fsubjectId} FSUBJECT_ID, #{subjectType} SUBJECT_TYPE,#{subjectLevel} SUBJECT_LEVEL,#{balFlag} BAL_FLAG,#{dataSource} DATA_SOURCE, #{status} STATUS,#{remark} REMARK,#{errMsg} ERR_MSG,#{createUser} CREATE_USER, #{createDept} CREATE_DEPT,#{createTime} CREATE_TIME,#{updateUser} UPDATE_USER,#{updateTime} UPDATE_TIME from dual )TEMP
) a )b set a.SUBJECT_NAME = b.SUBJECT_NAME, a.FSUBJECT_ID = b.FSUBJECT_ID, a.SUBJECT_TYPE = b.SUBJECT_TYPE, a.SUBJECT_LEVEL = b.SUBJECT_LEVEL, a.BAL_FLAG = b.BAL_FLAG, a.STATUS = b.STATUS, a.REMARK = b.REMARK, a.ERR_MSG = b.ERR_MSG, a.UPDATE_USER = b.UPDATE_USER, a.UPDATE_TIME = b.UPDATE_TIME where a.BOOKSET_ID = b.BOOKSET_ID and a.SUBJECT_NO = b.SUBJECT_NO
